Every tracker is free. Kitsu, Simkl and Last.fm only need a sign-in; AniList and MyAnimeList need a free key you create once, SubDL a free API key, and Trakt uses the built-in key or your own. Yumeiro has no server, so your sign-in goes straight to the service. Tap ? on a card for the steps.
Tokens and keys are encrypted with the Android Keystore and never leave the device except to talk to the tracker. They\'re not included in backups.
Your password goes to Kitsu once; only the token is kept.
Create a free app at developer.trakt.tv/apps/new with this redirect URI, then paste its Client ID. New Trakt apps have no client secret; fill it in only if Trakt shows one.

Nothing in Yumeiro needs AI. For You, Similar by story and the reasons for each pick come from AniList and TMDB data. With your own key, Yumeiro can also answer questions in the Assistant and translate subtitles with AI. The key is kept on this device for this profile only, sealed by Android\'s Keystore.

• Assistant: needs a key.
• Subtitle translation: works without a key on phones (on-device translator); AI is used when chosen or on TV.
• For You, Similar by story, the why sheet and Not interested: never need AI.
What is sent: your question, the taste summary of this profile for that kind of media (titles and tags, nothing else), and the facts Yumeiro found. Reddit and X can't be searched (no free API).
